source(output(
		deliveryMethodConfigId as integer,
		ntid as string,
		fileFormatConfigId as integer,
		reportId as integer,
		reportName as string,
		deliveryLocation as string,
		reportNetworkLocation as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select reportId, reportName, deliveryLocation, reportNetworkLocation, fileFormatConfigId, deliveryMethodConfigId, fileFormatConfigName, deliveryMethodConfigName, reportScheduleId, startDate, endDate, frequency, frequencyConfigName, timeslot, timeslotConfigName, ntid from (select reportId, reportName, deliveryLocation, reportNetworkLocation, fileFormatConfigId, deliveryMethodConfigId, fileFormatConfigName, deliveryMethodConfigName, reportScheduleId, startDate, endDate, frequency, frequencyConfigName, timeslot, timeslotConfigName, ntid, [reportCatConfigId], ntile(2) over (order by reportId desc) grp_nbr from  ##report (nolock)   )a where grp_nbr=2',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GetScheduledReports
GetScheduledReports sink(input(
		deliveryMethodConfigId as integer,
		ntid as string,
		fileFormatConfigId as integer,
		reportId as integer,
		reportName as string,
		deliveryLocation as string,
